name: Directional Occlusion Shading
definition: An occlusion-based shading method for interactive direct volume rendering that provides perceptual cues similar to ambient occlusion for solid and transparent surface-like features without precomputation.
summary: Directional Occlusion Shading is an interactive volume rendering technique that approximates in-scattered radiance using a cone-shaped phase function to model directional occlusion without precomputation.
